name: Environmental Action Group Potluck
description: This event is the first meeting of for Environmental Action Group this semester. We will have free food and drinks for people. People are also encouraged to bring their own food to share if they are able. We will be talking about what people want to do this semester and getting to know each other.

name: Meatless Mondays
description: EAG is hosting "Meatless Mondays"! Every Monday, a table in the DH will be reserved for "meatless meals" to help promote healthier, more sustainable eating habits. Come sit with us to learn more about the power of your food choices!

name: Swamp Rabbit Birthday Bike Ride
description: EAG is riding down to the Swamp Rabbit Cafe to celebrate the Swamp Rabbit's birthday with the Greenville community. Come join us at the UC parking lot at 11 if you would like to join!

name: Running Out of Water: Or just another six-point plan to resolve the water crisis?
description: Keynote Address by Peter Rodgers, Harvard professor of Environmental Engineering. Open Q & A following lecture. Part of the Global Issues Forum Spring Series. Prof. Peter Rogers is Gordon McKay Professor of Environmental Engineering and Professor of City Planning in the Division of Engineering and Applied Sciences at Harvard University. He is a member of the Technical Advisory Committee of the Global Water Partnership, recipient of Guggenheim and Twentieth Century Fellowships. He has carried out extensive field and model studies on population, water and energy resources, and environmental problems in Costa Rica, Pakistan, India, China, the Philippines, Bangladesh and, to a lesser extent, in 25 other countries. His most recent work has focused on the relationship between Chinese electric power developments and their impact on global warming.
